nodes.label: Deterministic check_id Hash
nodes.rationale: Hash of membership digest, tool version, kind and subjects so identical inputs give the same result and blob.

nodes.label: Decimal Strings, 4dp ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Never Float
nodes.rationale: Pure functions over the pinned snapshot with no clock and no I/O except archiving result blobs, keeping results deterministic and reproducible.

nodes.label: run_check Allowlisted Dispatcher
nodes.rationale: Accepts only an allowlist of check kinds (COMPARE_IDENTITY, LOOKUP_REGISTRATION_EVIDENCE, CHECK_CAPABILITY, LOOKUP_PRODUCT_MAPPING, COMPARE_WEIGHT_BASIS, AGGREGATE_SALES, GET_CERTIFICATE_HISTORY, CHECK_CREDIT_EVENTS, MATCH_TRANSACTIONS); unknown kinds are rejected.

nodes.label: TOOL_VERSION In Calculation Digest
nodes.rationale: Because TOOL_VERSION is part of the calculation digest, any rule change must bump it so pinned runs remain reproducible.

nodes.label: Run Mode And Budgets From Frozen Backend Configuration
nodes.norm_label: run mode and budgets from frozen backend configuration

nodes.label: Only Affirmative Evidence Demotes (UNKNOWN Default)
nodes.rationale: Missing, unreviewed or undated evidence is UNKNOWN, never a silent pass and never an exclusion; checks only demote and never promote support.

nodes.label: Capability Verdict Rule (F10 EEE Code Coverage)
nodes.norm_label: capability verdict rule (f10 eee code coverage)
nodes.rationale: Applies only when both a Registration and a ProductMapping exist; FAIL when no EEE code is covered, UNKNOWN when only some are; a purely alphabetic code (CEEW) covers numbered items (CEEW1), others match exactly.

nodes.label: Chronology Verdict Rule (Half-Open Spans, Ties Are UNKNOWN)
nodes.norm_label: chronology verdict rule (half-open spans, ties are unknown)
nodes.rationale: Explicit allocation_order beats Allocation.allocation_time; a transfer's time is never used as allocation time; missing, partial or tied order is UNKNOWN.

nodes.label: Commercial Verdict Rule (F07/T09 Invoice-Payment Grouping)
nodes.rationale: An invoice and its payment count once and money is never credit; contradictions in parties, metal or quantity fail the whole linked group, and rejected groups consume no commercial transfer capacity (tool version c08-s04-0.2).

nodes.label: Lifecycle Verdict Rule (F09 Expired/Cancelled Credits)
nodes.rationale: FAIL only when a supported EXPIRED/CANCELLED fact precedes transfer or allocation; absence of terminal evidence passes but the trace notes absence is not proof; unsupported, undated or unorderable facts are UNKNOWN.

nodes.label: WEIGHT_BASIS_CONFLICT (F13)
nodes.rationale: Two bases or weights in force together are escalated, never averaged; sales aggregated per basis; fiscal years run 1 April to 1 April.

nodes.label: Whole Pinned Snapshot Is The Checked Universe
nodes.norm_label: whole pinned snapshot is the checked universe
nodes.rationale: Request subjects only select which results come back; checks always run against every active record so selection cannot hide contradictions.

nodes.label: All Decisions And Calculations Stay In Backend
nodes.norm_label: all decisions and calculations stay in backend
nodes.rationale: The UI only takes a synthetic dossier through readiness, investigation, verified report and human review; it never computes compliance results itself.

nodes.label: Lost Start Responses Locked Against Duplicate Submission
nodes.norm_label: lost start responses locked against duplicate submission
nodes.rationale: An uncertain run-start outcome must not trigger a second run; recent runs provide read-only recovery and a concurrent run yields a 409.

nodes.label: API Token Held Only In Page Memory
nodes.norm_label: api token held only in page memory
nodes.rationale: Credentials are never persisted, so the token is re-entered after reload; plain HTTP transport means use only on a private network.
